shared_instructions:
Every shell command string submitted to an execution tool must start with rtk, including bootstrap reads (for example, rtk proxy cat /home/johnm/.codex/RTK.md). Downstream pipeline stages within the same shell string need not repeat the prefix; each separately executed shell string must follow it. These are your complete task instructions, supplied directly at launch; no separate participant instruction-file read is needed.

You are completing one isolated evaluation task. Your task root is {{ROOT}}. Work only in that root. Mandatory host instruction/bootstrap reads are separately allowed. Every shell command must start with rtk; use rtk proxy for unfiltered reads and tests. Source exploration may use file listings, literal/regex searches and full or bounded reads. Use rg --hidden --no-ignore where needed, excluding controller state with --glob '!.aide/**'. Do not read outside source, other trials, grader/reference packages, memories, prior results or runtime logs. Do not use internet, subagents or commits. All native/global aide MCP tools and direct aide CLI calls are prohibited because they bind to another project. Assisted trials may only invoke their supplied bridge; permission to execute it does not permit reading it, the binary or evidence directory. Do not inspect, alter or reindex controller-created .aide state. The controller seeds the same index before each trial; indexed search/references can be stale after edits, so verify current source. Choose retrieval naturally; no tool is mandatory. Aim for at most 40 source/edit/test calls, counting nested calls individually; finish correct work if more is needed and explain why. Instruction/bootstrap and discovery calls are excluded from that advisory target but remain measured. Follow the task's read-only/edit boundary. End with the requested answer/change and verification; do not speculate about saved tokens.

treatments.ordinary: Use ordinary shell/file retrieval. Do not use aide retrieval or the bridge.
treatments.assisted:
Five optional fixture-scoped retrieval capabilities are available only through this command:
`rtk proxy python3 {{BRIDGE}} call --root {{ROOT}} --binary {{BINARY}} --evidence-dir {{EVIDENCE}} --tool-json '{"name":"code_search","arguments":{"query":"example"}}'`
Replace only the tool JSON. Every request has exactly `name` and `arguments`. Use one of these argument shapes (paths are relative to your root; replace sample names and paths):
- `code_search`: `{"query":"name or signature"}`; optional `file`, `kind`, `lang`, `limit`.
- `code_references`: `{"symbol":"functionName"}` or `{"symbols":["first","second"]}`; optional `file`, `kind`, `limit`.
- `code_symbols`: `{"file":"src/example.ts"}`.
- `code_outline`: `{"file":"src/example.ts"}`; optional boolean `keep_comments`.
- `code_read_symbol`: `{"file":"src/example.ts","symbols":["first","second"]}` or `{"file":"src/example.ts","symbol":"functionName"}`; optional `kind`, `start_line`. Symbol batches contain at most ten names.
Do not invoke the controller-only `prepare` command. Bridge failures do not authorize other aide access.

## Code Retrieval

For code tasks, discover aide's code tools when available: `code_search` for definitions by name/signature; `code_references` for callers and impact candidates; `code_symbols` or `code_outline` when file structure is unknown. With known files and symbols, go straight to bodies via `code_read_symbol` (batch related symbols) or bounded reads.
Use text search for literals/imports and direct reads for small files or when most contents matter. Reuse sufficient current source evidence; avoid fetching unchanged bodies through both symbol and direct reads without a specific gap. Read again when needed for missing context or post-edit verification. Verify discovery candidates against current source; a current symbol-body read can supply that evidence. Empty or stale results are not proof of absence.

overlap_review.definition: A source-body read overlaps an earlier complete current body read without an intervening edit. Record body identity, outputs and response association; judge a specific missing-context rationale separately. A direct read that also supplies missing imports/callers is not wholly redundant.
overlap_review.exclude: Post-edit verification, truncated earlier bodies, stale/ambiguous candidates and needed surrounding context.
overlap_review.report: Separate duplicate-only retrieval commands from partially overlapping outputs; distinguish within-response overlap from an additional response. Never convert observed overlap to counterfactual saved calls or tokens.
